question: Necessary same-date comparison and pre-alert balance diagnostic for R95 monthly positive versus negative accounting coherence
population: All1565 original monthly alerts retained; R95 frozen sign grouping unchanged; zero and unknown retained in census but not relabeled as controls
pairing: era/level/exact alert date; positive and negative each>=1. No propensity fit or nearest-neighbor tuning. Dates selected without future outcomes
metrics: excess20 primary; return20 and continuation_excess20_60 descriptive secondary
missing: A contrast for each metric exists only if every positive and negative group member has the metric. Otherwise whole date/metric unknown. Separate metric maturity ledgers. No zero fill
aggregation: within-group equal industries then positive-minus-negative perdate; equal complete dates. Report unmatched dates, zero/unknown cohort, source periods and signs. No p-values or predictive acceptance with at most one year/two economic periods
conclusion: same date controls calendar only; preexisting price imbalance, identity selection and full styles remain. If sparse or unstable stop short-source branch rather than tune
